explanation: OEIS A051293 (number of nonempty subsets of {1..n} with integer average), B. Cloitre: a(n) = 2^(n+1)/n · (1 + 1/n + 3/n² + 13/n³ + 75/n⁴ + 541/n⁵ + o(1/n⁵)). The formal a counts nonempty S ⊆ {1..n} with |S| dividing ΣS. The statement says (a(n) − 2^(n+1)/n·(1 + … + 541/n⁵)) divided by 2^(n+1)/n⁶ tends to 0, which is exactly the o(1/n⁵) error inside the bracket. Faithful.
